correctness.rationale: Independent-edge conditioning gives each forced motif vertex a parity character (-1)^d(1-2p)^(n-1-d), while vertices outside cancel. Summing copy indicators proves the covariance for every n and p. Each parity class has uniform summand sign and a nonzero leading coefficient from maximum-degree vertices at p=1/2. An independent exact-rational enumerator passed 338 checks.

value.rationale: A mod-two degree boundary is compared with every non-induced graph motif in two natural complete graph families. The exact sign law and midpoint zero multiplicity hold uniformly over disconnected and connected motifs, disclosing an ambient-parity phase phenomenon hidden in marginal edge/triangle counts. The value lies in this structural classification, not in novelty of parity characters.
